title: Design System: JB·DEV — Cracktro Void Queue

display.purpose: The name line only — the single brightest, largest element on the page.

text.purpose: Everything else. Rank within this one size is carried by dust token and letterspacing, never by a third size or heavier weight.

shadows.name: glow-name
shadows.purpose: Faint ivory emission on the name line. Emissive glow, never elevation.

shadows.name: glow-caret
shadows.purpose: Amber emission on the caret block — the system's heartbeat.

shadows.name: glow-link-probe
shadows.purpose: Amber emission on contact links and language switch options answering a hover/focus probe.

shadows.name: glow-lang-active
shadows.purpose: Amber emission on the active language option.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Shared drift vector for the three rear dust fields. Period encodes depth: far 90s, mid 55s, near 32s. Rear layers only — the front plane is still.

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: Hard-cut blink of the amber caret — the only motion allowed on the front plane. Frozen (caret stays lit) under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: probe-transition
motion.purpose: Contact links transitioning to the amber probe answer on hover/focus-visible.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Shed letterspacing steps, never brightness steps: queue d2–d4 to 0.3em, deep aside to 0.28em, name to 0.06em, role line to 0.3em, links to 0.24em.

components.name: Name Line + Caret
components.description: The signature element: one bitmap face at the display clamp, dead still at the front plane, with a hard-blinking amber caret at its head.
components.css: .ds-name { margin: 0; font-family: var(--f-bit, "Silkscreen", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: var(--display, clamp(1.5rem, 5.2vw, 3.4rem)); letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--dust-0, #f2efe6); text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(242, 239, 230, .28); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5em; } .ds-caret { width: .45em; height: 1.05em; background: var(--amber, #e8a33d); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(232, 163, 61, .8); animation: ds-caret-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-caret-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-name { letter-spacing: .06em; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-caret { animation: none; } }

components.name: Queue Depth Lines
components.description: Four ranked lines stepping back into the void: each rank is one dust token darker and wider tracked. Brightness steps never shed; tracking steps shed below 640px.
components.html:
• WEB DEVELOPMENT
  • BACKEND & APIS
  • INFRASTRUCTURE · DOCKER · LINUX
  • ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
components.css: .ds-queue { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; font-family: var(--f-bit, "Silkscreen", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: var(--text, .75rem); } .ds-queue-item--d1 { color: var(--dust-1, #b9b6ac); letter-spacing: .3em; } .ds-queue-item--d2 { color: var(--dust-2, #7d7b74); letter-spacing: .4em; } .ds-queue-item--d3 { color: var(--dust-3, #4a4944); letter-spacing: .5em; } .ds-queue-item--d4 { color: var(--dust-3, #4a4944); letter-spacing: .6em; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-queue-item--d2, .ds-queue-item--d3, .ds-queue-item--d4 { letter-spacing: .3em; } }

components.name: Contact Link
components.description: Bare uppercase words on the front plane: light ash at rest, amber with a glow on probe. No underline, no enclosure, ever.
components.css: .ds-contact { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 1.2rem 2.6rem; } .ds-link { color: var(--dust-1, #b9b6ac); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--f-bit, "Silkscreen", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: var(--text, .75rem); letter-spacing: .34em; padding: .4rem .2rem; transition: color .2s, text-shadow .2s; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { color: var(--amber, #e8a33d); text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(232, 163, 61, .6); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e8a33d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-link { letter-spacing: .24em; } }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: A DIP switch for tongues: unstyled button, ES · EN. The active option burns amber. In the shipped page the active side is driven by html[lang] and flipped without reload by lang.js (localStorage persistence, browser-language default, Spanish fallback).
components.css: .ds-lang { background: none; border: 0; font-family: var(--f-bit, "Silkscreen", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: var(--text, .75rem); letter-spacing: .3em; color: var(--dust-2, #7d7b74); cursor: pointer; padding: .3rem .2rem; } .ds-lang:hover, .ds-lang:focus-visible { color: var(--dust-1, #b9b6ac); } .ds-lang:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--amber, #e8a33d); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-lang-sep { margin: 0 .35rem; color: var(--dust-3, #4a4944); } .ds-lang-opt--active { color: var(--amber, #e8a33d); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(232, 163, 61, .5); }

components.name: Board Mark
components.description: JB·DEV — the top-left identity mark. Pure typography at the text size, wide-tracked ash. No logo asset exists in this world.
components.css: .ds-board { font-family: var(--f-bit, "Silkscreen", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: var(--text, .75rem); letter-spacing: .5em; color: var(--dust-2, #7d7b74); }

components.name: Dust Field
components.description: One of three fixed, pointer-transparent dot fields drifting behind all content. Depth reads as drift rate: near 32s (shown), mid 55s (140px 110px tile), far 90s (90px 70px tile). Frozen under prefers-reduced-motion.
components.css: .ds-dust { position: fixed; inset: -100px; pointer-events: none; background-repeat: repeat; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--dust-2, #7d7b74) 1.2px, transparent 1.7px); background-size: 220px 170px; background-position: 80px 20px; animation: ds-drift 32s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-drift { from { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); } to { transform: translate3d(-160px, 90px, 0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dust { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is a worked queue built from a cracktro title screen: one bitmap face on an emissive black void, rank expressed as depth, dust drifting behind, nothing ever enclosed. The visitor lands in the void — three dust fields drifting at three speeds — and finds the name dead still and brightest at the center of the front plane, an amber caret blinking at its head. What Jesús does recedes behind him as a queue of lines stepping back into the dark; how to reach him sits at the front plane again, beside the caret.

The system is radically minimal in means — six colors, one typeface, two type sizes, zero containers — and maximal in discipline. Hierarchy is carried entirely by brightness and letterspacing; depth is a stepped ladder, never a shadow; state is a probe of amber. The page refuses every card, box, rule, and divider: overlap is allowed, enclosure never. Motion belongs to the rear layers alone; the front plane is still except for the caret's hard blink.
keyCharacteristics: Emissive black ground (#050505) with four dust neutrals ash-to-ivory and exactly one accent, signal amber.
One bitmap face (self-hosted Silkscreen) at exactly two sizes: a fluid display clamp and a single small text size.
Depth expressed as brightness step + letterspacing step + drift rate — never as shadow, lift, or overlap order.
No rules, boxes, dividers, or rounded surfaces anywhere; the only line in the system is the keyboard focus ring.
Rear-only motion: dust fields drift, the front plane is still except the amber caret's steps(1) blink.
Bilingual ES/EN in one document, flipped without reload; no trackers, no cookies, no external requests.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber is used only where the system is alive: the caret, the active language, a hover/focus probe, the focus ring, the selection fill. Amber is never used for resting body text, decoration, or large fills. If amber appears and nothing is being signaled, remove it.

rules.name: The Dust Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text steps back by switching dust tokens, never by applying opacity. A rank is a color: d1 = --dust-1, d2 = --dust-2, d3/d4 = --dust-3. Opacity fades the bitmap face; the ladder keeps every glyph crisp.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: One bitmap face at exactly two sizes: the fluid display clamp and the one small text size. Hierarchy is brightness + letterspacing, never a third size, a second family, or a heavier weight.

rules.name: The Narrow-Shed Rule
rules.body: Below 640px, shed tracking steps, never brightness steps. Depth must remain legible by color alone when the screen is too narrow to afford wide letterspacing.

rules.name: The Rank-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: Rank is depth, and depth is brightness step + letterspacing step (+ drift rate for dust). Never reach for shadows, scale, borders, or z-stacking to separate ranks.

rules.name: The Rear-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion belongs to the rear layers: the dust fields drift, the front plane is still. The sole exception is the amber caret, which blinks with a hard steps(1) cut at 1.1s. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, both stop — the dust freezes and the caret stays lit.

rules.name: The Enclosure-Never Rule
rules.body: No cards, boxes, borders, dividers, or rounded surfaces — ever. If a grouping needs to be visible, express it with spacing, brightness, and tracking instead.

dos: Do keep every word Silkscreen, and keep it to exactly two sizes — the display clamp (clamp(1.5rem, 5.2vw, 3.4rem)) and the one text size (0.75rem). Build hierarchy from dust tokens and letterspacing.
Do express rank as the depth ladder: one dust token darker + wider tracking per step back, drift reserved for dust.
Do keep the front plane still; the caret's steps(1) blink is the only motion allowed there.
Do reserve amber for signal — caret, active language, hover/focus probe, focus ring, selection.
Do keep focus-visible affordances exactly as shipped: 1px solid amber outline, 4px offset.
Do shed letterspacing steps (never brightness steps) below 640px, and honor prefers-reduced-motion by freezing dust and caret.
Do ship self-hosted assets only (woff2 with font-display: swap); zero external scripts, trackers, or cookies.
donts: Don't introduce cards, boxes, borders, rules, dividers, or rounded corners — enclosure never.
Don't add a second typeface, a third size, or heavier weights as hierarchy.
Don't use amber for resting text, decoration, or fills beyond the sanctioned selection state.
Don't use shadows as elevation or lift; the only shadows in this world are emissive glows.
Don't animate the front plane — no entrance animations, no hover motion on content, no drifting text.
Don't fade ranks with opacity; step them with the dust ladder so glyphs stay crisp.
Don't underline links or wrap them in containers.
